elaine: quick flag PR 1101 landed but the tracing-hooks migration doc still points at /v1/traces/setup (404). can someone swap it before we cut the release?

ravi: where in the doc? i can do a minimal PR to fix the link + update the python example.

elaine: under 'Install the hook' near the top. also the python snippet uses the old Client(...) constructor which breaks with sdk v2. current snippet: `from redwood_sdk import Client
client = Client(api_key=\"${REDWOOD_KEY}\")`

sofia: we changed that in 2.1. new usage is `from redwood_sdk import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv(\"REDWOOD_KEY\"))`. i'll open a PR to replace the link and swap the snippet to the new API and show env var usage.

mike: while you're at it, please add a one-line pointer to Console > Observability > Token cost breakdown. customers keep opening tickets after migrating and a short note should cut noise.

sofia: will add a single-line callout and a screenshot placeholder (with alt text). do we have a canonical console URL to link?

ravi: use https://app.redwood.ai/console/observability/costs (it will redirect in-prod) or the short internal route /console/observability/token-costs?utm=docs. either is fine.

elaine: also the snippet references `service.version` span attribute which we no longer emit. either remove it or mark as legacy.

sofia: i'll replace it with `span.set_attribute(\"deployment\", \"blue\")` and add a small note: \"upgrading from <2024-10 may show older attribute names\".

mike: tiny suggestion: include a short legacy shim for folks on older SDKs so they don't hit support. a 4-line `if hasattr(...)` fallback is enough.

ravi: proposed shim: ```python
from redwood_sdk import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv(\"REDWOOD_KEY\"))
# legacy fallback for older SDKs
if not hasattr(client, \"track_span\"):
    def track_span(name, **attrs):
        return client.create_span(name, attributes=attrs)
    client.track_span = track_span
```

elaine: perfect. last bit: doc-bot reported an orphaned image link `https://storage.redwood.ai/missing/trace-costs.png` which 404s in the site build. replace it with the new screenshot or remove it.

sofia: i'll swap it for the updated screenshot from design and include alt text and a caption.

doc-bot: automated check: draft PR 1104 by sofia includes link fix, sdk snippet update, legacy shim, screenshot replacement. staging preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1104 rendering OK. no broken links detected.

mike: quick review: please add a one-line changelog bullet under \"What changed\" on the migration page: \"SDK v2: client initialization and span attribute names updated; see migration snippet.\" and bump the last-updated date.

sofia: added the changelog bullet and updated date. pushing commits now.

ravi: LGTM. pinging @docs-rollback for visibility in case a hotfix is needed.

elaine: thanks all \":thumbsup:\". i'll include this in the 2024-11 console release notes and follow up if QA sees anything.

mike: thanks team :rocket:
